module: Node "Beamstate" (category `once_p_duration`, tags destroy/damage/funstuff). Calls a parameterless function of `beamstate` on the vehicle side, chosen in a dropdown list: `breakAllBreakgroups`, `breakHinges`, `deflateTires`. Input pin: `vehId` (number, required). Executed once.
notes: Unlike other nodes, there is no fallback to the player vehicle: without a valid `vehId`, nothing happens.
`drawCustomProperties` does not return `reason` (empty return): the function change is not reported to the editor.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_onDeserialized.desc: Called when the project loads; restores the node's settings from `nodeData`.

_onSerialize.desc: Called when the project is saved; copies the node's settings into the `res` table.

drawCustomProperties.desc: ImGui display of the node's properties in the editor panel; returns a string describing the change made, or nil.

drawMiddle.desc: ImGui display in the center of the node in the flowgraph editor; purely visual.

init.desc: Node constructor, called at its creation by the flowgraph editor/manager; initializes the internal state.

workOnce.desc: Sends `beamstate.<chosen function>()` to the vehicle `vehId` via `queueLuaCommand`. Does nothing if the vehicle does not exist.
